metadata.title: Relativistic tidal separation of binary stars by supermassive black holes

notes: No eligible individual stars are identifiable. The paper studies simulated populations of generic binary members and refers only generically to potential HVS/EMRI outcomes (e.g., T:p11-b7 and T:p12-b4); it supplies no star name or source identifier. Contextual references to HVSs and S-stars, including T:p1-b10, T:p1-b11, and T:p25-b2, do not identify specific unbound stars studied here.
